flyer.justification: The flyer is concise, high-impact, uses TBA placeholders appropriately, and adheres strictly to the title length requirement.

instagram.justification: The caption features strong formatting, engaging emoji bullet points, an active call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

linkedin.justification: The post has an engaging hook, smooth paragraph flow, exactly 5 relevant hashtags, and avoids banned cliches and buzzwords.

newsletter.justification: The subject line is under 50 characters, and the body includes a greeting, three bold-subheaded sections, and clear call-to-action links.

blog.justification: The long-form article is well structured with numbered sections, detailed narrative examples, a comparison table, and an About the Author section.

summary.justification: The executive summary includes all required structural components (TL;DR, key evidence, discussion points, action items) well under the 400-word limit.
